## Introduction

The robust estimation of the first two moments in one single cluster is a key step in many statistical methods, such as clustering, classification or regression.
All robust methods provide accurate estimates of the variance, even in presence of a large fraction of outliers.
Once these quantities being estimated, the detection of outliers is naturally performed using robust distances, such as the Mahalanobis distance.
